status_note: PROVISIONAL. Draft Deviation 65 is not adopted. Every value below is the draft's recommendation (its Section 9) or, where marked 'found in implementation', a reading the draft left open. The review or the PI changes this table, not code. Anything computed under a provisional table is exploratory and says so.

primary_calibration.meaning: Which calibration the registered row is drawn on. per_value_at_or_before_running: for every published value, the entry with the latest date at or before the job's running time among the sets of the pool. set_in_force_at_running: the set in force at running as published. first_set_after_finished: the first set published at or after finished.

general_entries_rule.draft: Section 4.2 names 'each general entry' under the per-value rule; found in implementation: the general entries (ZZ and J couplings) carry the publication time of their set as their date, not a measurement time
general_entries_rule.meaning: How the general entries are taken under the per-value rule. by_date: by their date like every other value, which today means from the set in force at running. from_set_in_force_at_running: the same result stated as a rule, so that it stays if IBM starts dating them by measurement. The two differ only if a general entry of a later set is dated at or before running.

coupler_zone_rule.meaning: When a coupler over the CZ cut counts as lying in the L = 2 cone of the observable: both of its qubits in the cone, or either.

coupler_cone_rule.draft: not stated; found in implementation (Section 4.5 gives the coupler rule for the L = 2 zone only)
coupler_cone_rule.meaning: When a coupler over the CZ cut counts as lying in the point's own light cone (the 'elsewhere in the cone' row). either_qubit is the reading that never drops a flag: a two-qubit error on a coupler acts on its cone qubit whether or not the partner is in the cone.

zone_for_points_shallower_than_zone.draft: not stated; found in implementation (for a point with L = 1 the L = 2 cone is larger than the point's own cone, and the table of Section 4.5 gives both 'not evaluable' and 'read' for an element between the two)
zone_for_points_shallower_than_zone.meaning: zone_applies: an over-cut element in the L = 2 cone makes a point not evaluable whatever its L (the table read from the top). own_cone_only: for a point with L below 2 only its own cone counts.

decision_line_abs_ln_ratio.allowed: a positive number, or null for no line (flags only)
decision_line_abs_ln_ratio.meaning: A flagged point whose |ln(P_E / P_dispatch)| exceeds this is not evaluable without the PI's decision.

fallback_when_execution_calibration_cann.meaning: What a point is read against when the pool is pending or stopped.

split_point_rule.meaning: How a point whose executions are split over jobs with different execution-time calibrations is read.

value_age_bound_hours.allowed: null (ages recorded, no bound) or a positive number of hours
value_age_bound_hours.meaning: A bound on the age at running of the readout values of the execution-time calibration. null: the age of every value class is recorded and nothing is refused.

bracket_decides_gate2e.draft: Section 9, choice 5 (recommended: the execution-time figures decide, the bracket figures are reported)
bracket_decides_gate2e.meaning: Whether the readout figures of the bracket calibration also pause under Gate 2 (e). Not read by any code on this branch; read by the gate2_e patch of docs/deviations_drafts/65_implementation/.

dispatch_window.meaning: The window in which a package may be dispatched. Not read by any code on this branch; it belongs to the same-day pipeline scripts.
